bio: Sundar Pichai has been CEO of Google since 2015 and of its parent company, Alphabet, since 2019. He joined Google in 2004 and led products including the Chrome browser and Android. Alphabet's businesses include Search, YouTube, Google Cloud and artificial intelligence research.
